text: 上周五美股收涨，纳指涨1%，亚马逊大涨15%，苹果大跌7%；布油期货周一亚市开盘大跌6.7%。 TACO！特朗普“取消对伊朗打击”，并称美伊3日将举行谈判。沙特王储曾致电美方“敦促缓和局势”。伊朗外长：伊朗与阿曼谈判接近完成。 部署下半年八大重点！中国央行定调：适时调整、加力扩内需。 被“忽略”的市场大事：美日韩联合干预，美国财政部“罕见”下场。 单日7.2万亿韩元，外资周五净买入创纪录！华尔街：韩股资金面逆风已经消退。 长鑫LPDDR6迎来关键突破。 OpenAI确认下一代模型Astra存在，以2000美元算力成本破解十项数学未解难题，正向监管层展示。
text_en: US stocks rose on Friday, Nasdaq up 1%, Amazon surged 15%, Apple plunged 7%; Brent crude futures dropped 6.7% at Asia market open Monday. TACO! Trump "called off strike on Iran," said US-Iran talks to be held in 3 days. Saudi Crown Prince phoned US urging de-escalation. Iran's FM: Talks with Oman near completion. PBOC sets tone for H2 eight priorities: timely adjustments, strengthening domestic demand expansion. A "ignored" market event: US-Japan-South Korea joint intervention, US Treasury's rare involvement. Single-day KRW 7.2 trillion, foreign net buying hit record Friday! Wall Street: Korean stock liquidity headwinds have faded. ChangXin LPDDR6 achieves key breakthrough. OpenAI confirms next-gen model Astra exists, solved ten unsolved math problems at $2000 computing cost, showcasing to regulators.
